Turn to the north: This game trains spatial memory through touch. First tap 'Start sensing' - you'll feel a sequence of vibrations. Each direction has its own number of vibrations: left - one, up - two, right - three, down - four. Count and remember them carefully, in order. Then, on the cross-shaped pad below, tap the same directions in the same order you felt them. If you want to feel the sequence again before answering, tap 'Sense again'. Each round adds one more step to the sequence - the game has 10 rounds in total.
